# Import data
Import csv data, reduced dataset is excluding AoA = 5. Because we saw the force data when AoA = 5  is unstable, we decided to filtered out AoA = 5 data to see if it will gave us better prediction as _reduced. Accroding to the lower pressure taps are maxed out during test, we just use upper pressure data to predict the delta_L_D value.

After the data organization, inputs of datasets to use for the model are:
```{r}
check_alignment <- function(force_data, pressure_data) {
  key_cols <- c("XPos", "YPos", "ZPos", "AoA")

  diff <- all.equal(force_data[key_cols], pressure_data[key_cols])
  
  if (isTRUE(diff)) {
    print("Datasets are correctly aligned!")
    return(TRUE)
  } else {
    warning("Mismatch found! Differences detected:")
    print(diff)  
    return(FALSE)
  }
}

check_alignment(force_selected_test, force_selected_test)
check_alignment(force_selected_train, force_selected_train)
check_alignment(force_selected_reduced_train, pressure_selected_reduced_train)
check_alignment(force_selected_reduced_test, pressure_selected_reduced_test)

# Create a meta data model for training:
data_model_train_full <- merge(force_selected_train, pressure_selected_train, 
                              by = c("XPos", "YPos", "ZPos", "AoA"))
#data_model_train_full$AoA <- as.factor(data_model_train_full$AoA)

data_model_train_reduced <- merge(force_selected_reduced_train, pressure_selected_reduced_train, 
                              by = c("XPos", "YPos", "ZPos", "AoA"))
#data_model_train_reduced$AoA <- as.factor(data_model_train_reduced$AoA)

# Meta data model for testing:
data_model_test_full <- merge(force_selected_test, pressure_selected_test,
```

# R-squared calculation function
Equation: https://www.listendata.com/2014/08/adjusted-r-squared.html#:~:text=Adjusted%20R%2Dsquared%20value%20is%20calculated%20using%20the%20formula%3A%201,variables)%20in%20the%20regression%20model.
```{r}
calculate_r_squared <- function(actual, predicted) {
  rss <- sum((actual - predicted)^2)
  tss <- sum((actual - mean(actual))^2)
  r2 <- 1 - (rss / tss)
  return(r2)
}

calculate_adjusted_r_squared <- function(actual, predicted, num_predictors) {
  n <- length(actual)
  r2 <- calculate_r_squared(actual, predicted)
  adj_r2 <- 1 - ((1 - r2) * (n - 1) / (n - num_predictors - 1))
  return(adj_r2)
}
```

# Check stats function
```{r}
check_stats <- function(model, train_data, test_data, target_column, num_predictors) {

  # Predictions
  predicted_train <- predict(model, newdata = train_data)
  predicted_test <- predict(model, newdata = test_data)
  
  # RMSE 
  rmse_train <- RMSE(predicted_train, train_data[[target_column]])
  rmse_test <- RMSE(predicted_test, test_data[[target_column]])
  
  # R-squared
  r2_train <- calculate_r_squared(train_data[[target_column]], predicted_train)
  r2_test <- calculate_r_squared(test_data[[target_column]], predicted_test)
  
  # Adjusted R-squared
  adj_r2_train <- calculate_adjusted_r_squared(train_data[[target_column]], predicted_train, num_predictors)
  adj_r2_test <- calculate_adjusted_r_squared(test_data[[target_column]], predicted_test, num_predictors)
  
  # Print results
  print(paste("Train R-squared:", round(r2_train, 4)))
  print(paste("Test R-squared:", round(r2_test, 4)))
  print(paste("Train Adjusted R-squared:", round(adj_r2_train, 4)))
  print(paste("Test Adjusted R-squared:", round(adj_r2_test, 4)))
  print(paste("Train RMSE:", round(rmse_train, 4)))
  print(paste("Test RMSE:", round(rmse_test, 4)))
  
  # Return all stats as a list
  return(list(
    predicted_train = predicted_train,
    predicted_test = predicted_test,
    rmse_train = rmse_train,
    rmse_test = rmse_test,
    r2_train = r2_train,
    r2_test = r2_test,
    adj_r2_train = adj_r2_train,
    adj_r2_test = adj_r2_test
  ))
}

```

# Model 1 using all taps
## Linear regression
Using linear regression model to predict delta_L_D by using delta_pressure
Predictor: 
  numeric(Tap0_delta_pressure_mean)
    .
    .
    .
  numeric(Tap19_delta_pressure_mean)
  
Object:
  numeric(delta_L_D_mean)
  
```{r}
# Linear regression full model with AOA
Model_LM_with_AoA <- lm(delta_L_D_mean ~ tap0_delta_pressure_mean + tap2_delta_pressure_mean + tap4_delta_pressure_mean + tap6_delta_pressure_mean + tap8_delta_pressure_mean
                           + tap9_delta_pressure_mean + tap10_delta_pressure_mean +
                           tap11_delta_pressure_mean + tap13_delta_pressure_mean + tap15_delta_pressure_mean + tap17_delta_pressure_mean + tap19_delta_pressure_mean
                           + AoA
                           , data = data_model_train_full)
# summary(Model_LM_with_AoA)

# Linear regression full model without AOA
Model_LM_without_AoA <- lm(delta_L_D_mean ~ tap0_delta_pressure_mean + tap2_delta_pressure_mean + tap4_delta_pressure_mean + tap6_delta_pressure_mean + tap8_delta_pressure_mean
                           + tap9_delta_pressure_mean + tap10_delta_pressure_mean +
                           tap11_delta_pressure_mean + tap13_delta_pressure_mean + tap15_delta_pressure_mean + tap17_delta_pressure_mean + tap19_delta_pressure_mean
                           , data = data_model_train_full)

Model_LM_Without_AoA_with_XYZ <- lm(delta_L_D_mean ~ tap0_delta_pressure_mean + tap2_delta_pressure_mean + tap4_delta_pressure_mean + tap6_delta_pressure_mean + tap8_delta_pressure_mean
                           + tap9_delta_pressure_mean + tap10_delta_pressure_mean +
                           tap11_delta_pressure_mean + tap13_delta_pressure_mean + tap15_delta_pressure_mean + tap17_delta_pressure_mean + tap19_delta_pressure_mean
                           + XPos + YPos + ZPos
                           , data = data_model_train_full)

Model_LM_with_AoA_with_XYZ <- lm(delta_L_D_mean ~ tap0_delta_pressure_mean + tap2_delta_pressure_mean + tap4_delta_pressure_mean + tap6_delta_pressure_mean + tap8_delta_pressure_mean
                           + tap9_delta_pressure_mean + tap10_delta_pressure_mean +
                           tap11_delta_pressure_mean + tap13_delta_pressure_mean + tap15_delta_pressure_mean + tap17_delta_pressure_mean + tap19_delta_pressure_mean
                           + XPos + YPos + ZPos
                           + AoA
                           , data = data_model_train_full)

n_predictors_without_AoA <- length(coef(Model_LM_without_AoA)) - 1
n_predictors_with_AoA <- length(coef(Model_LM_with_AoA)) - 1
n_predictors_with_XYZ <- length(coef(Model_LM_with_AoA_with_XYZ)) - 1
n_predictors_without_XYZ <- length(coef(Model_LM_Without_AoA_with_XYZ)) - 1

# Compute stats for each model
stats_LM_with_AoA <- check_stats(Model_LM_with_AoA, data_model_train_full, data_model_test_full, "delta_L_D_mean", num_predictors = n_predictors_with_AoA)

stats_LM_with_AoA_with_XYZ <- check_stats(Model_LM_with_AoA_with_XYZ, data_model_train_full, data_model_test_full, "delta_L_D_mean", num_predictors = n_predictors_with_XYZ)

stats_LM_without_AoA <- check_stats(Model_LM_without_AoA, data_model_train_full, data_model_test_full, "delta_L_D_mean", num_predictors = n_predictors_without_AoA)

stats_LM_without_AoA_with_XYZ <- check_stats(Model_LM_Without_AoA_with_XYZ, data_model_train_full, data_model_test_full, "delta_L_D_mean", num_predictors = n_predictors_without_XYZ)
```

```{r}
stats_GAM_with_AoA_reduced <- check_stats(Model_GAM_with_AoA_reduced, data_model_train_reduced, data_model_test_reduced, "delta_L_D_mean", num_predictors = n_predictors_GAM_with_AoA_reduced)

stats_GAM_without_AoA_reduced <- check_stats(Model_GAM_without_AoA_reduced, data_model_train_reduced, data_model_test_reduced, "delta_L_D_mean", num_predictors = n_predictors_GAM_without_AoA_reduced)
```

## Gradient Boosting
```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(Metrics)   # for RMSE()

# ---- Build merged modeling frames and feature matrices (FULL set) ----
key_cols <- c("XPos","YPos","ZPos","AoA")

# Merge force (target) with pressure (features) by keys
data_model_train_full <- merge(
  force_selected_train,  pressure_selected_train,  by = key_cols
)
data_model_test_full <- merge(
  force_selected_test,   pressure_selected_test,   by = key_cols
)

# Sanity check: must have rows after merge
stopifnot(nrow(data_model_train_full) > 0, nrow(data_model_test_full) > 0)

# Pressure-tap feature columns (12 taps, upper row)
tap_cols <- c(
  "tap0_delta_pressure_mean","tap2_delta_pressure_mean","tap4_delta_pressure_mean",
  "tap6_delta_pressure_mean","tap8_delta_pressure_mean","tap9_delta_pressure_mean",
  "tap10_delta_pressure_mean","tap11_delta_pressure_mean","tap13_delta_pressure_mean",
  "tap15_delta_pressure_mean","tap17_delta_pressure_mean","tap19_delta_pressure_mean"
)

# Labels
train_labels_full <- data_model_train_full$delta_L_D_mean
test_labels_full  <- data_model_test_full$delta_L_D_mean

# Feature matrices expected later
# taps + AoA
train_matrix_full_with_AoA <- as.matrix(
  data_model_train_full[, c(tap_cols, "AoA")]
)
test_matrix_full_with_AoA <- as.matrix(
  data_model_test_full[, c(tap_cols, "AoA")]
)

# taps only (no AoA, no XYZ)
train_matrix_full_without_AoA <- as.matrix(
  data_model_train_full[, tap_cols]
)
test_matrix_full_without_AoA <- as.matrix(
  data_model_test_full[, tap_cols]
)

# taps + XYZ (no AoA)  — i.e., everything except target and AoA
train_matrix_full_XYZ <- as.matrix(
  data_model_train_full[, !(names(data_model_train_full) %in% c("delta_L_D_mean","AoA"))]
)
test_matrix_full_XYZ <- as.matrix(
  data_model_test_full[, !(names(data_model_test_full)  %in% c("delta_L_D_mean","AoA"))]
)

# taps + AoA + XYZ (all predictors; only drop target)
train_matrix_full_all <- as.matrix(
  data_model_train_full[, names(data_model_train_full) != "delta_L_D_mean"]
)
test_matrix_full_all <- as.matrix(
  data_model_test_full[,  names(data_model_test_full)  != "delta_L_D_mean"]
)


set.seed(123)

# 1) Build DMatrix objects
# — taps + AoA (no XYZ)
dtrain_with <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = as.matrix(train_matrix_full_with_AoA),
  label = train_labels_full
)
dtest_with  <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = as.matrix(test_matrix_full_with_AoA),
  label = test_labels_full
)

# — taps only (no AoA, no XYZ)
dtrain_without <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = as.matrix(train_matrix_full_without_AoA),
  label = train_labels_full
)
dtest_without  <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = as.matrix(test_matrix_full_without_AoA),
  label = test_labels_full
)

# — taps + XYZ (no AoA)
train_matrix_full_XYZ <- as.matrix(
  data_model_train_full[, !(names(data_model_train_full) %in% c("delta_L_D_mean", "AoA"))]
)
test_matrix_full_XYZ  <- as.matrix(
  data_model_test_full[,  !(names(data_model_test_full)  %in% c("delta_L_D_mean", "AoA"))]
)
dtrain_XYZ <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = train_matrix_full_XYZ,
  label = train_labels_full
)
dtest_XYZ  <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = test_matrix_full_XYZ,
  label = test_labels_full
)

# — taps + AoA + XYZ (all features except target)
train_matrix_full_all <- as.matrix(
  data_model_train_full[, !(names(data_model_train_full) == "delta_L_D_mean")]
)
test_matrix_full_all  <- as.matrix(
  data_model_test_full[,  !(names(data_model_test_full)  == "delta_L_D_mean")]
)
dtrain_all <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = train_matrix_full_all,
  label = train_labels_full
)
dtest_all  <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data  = test_matrix_full_all,
  label = test_labels_full
)


# 2) Common XGB parameters
params <- list(
  objective        = "reg:squarederror",
  eta              = 0.05,
  max_depth        = 3,
  subsample        = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  lambda           = 1,
  alpha            = 0
)
nrounds <- 2000
early   <- 50


# 3) Train the four models

# a) With AoA, no XYZ
watchlist_with <- list(train = dtrain_with, test = dtest_with)
Model_GB_with_AoA <- xgb.train(
  params                = params,
  data                  = dtrain_with,
  nrounds               = nrounds,
  watchlist             = watchlist_with,
  early_stopping_rounds = early,
  verbose               = 1
)

# b) Without AoA, no XYZ
watchlist_without <- list(train = dtrain_without, test = dtest_without)
Model_GB_without_AoA <- xgb.train(
  params                = params,
  data                  = dtrain_without,
  nrounds               = nrounds,
  watchlist             = watchlist_without,
  early_stopping_rounds = early,
  verbose               = 1
)

# c) With XYZ, no AoA
watchlist_XYZ <- list(train = dtrain_XYZ, test = dtest_XYZ)
Model_GB_with_XYZ <- xgb.train(
  params                = params,
  data                  = dtrain_XYZ,
  nrounds               = nrounds,
  watchlist             = watchlist_XYZ,
  early_stopping_rounds = early,
  verbose               = 1
)

# d) With AoA and XYZ
watchlist_all <- list(train = dtrain_all, test = dtest_all)
Model_GB_with_AoA_XYZ <- xgb.train(
  params                = params,
  data                  = dtrain_all,
  nrounds               = nrounds,
  watchlist             = watchlist_all,
  early_stopping_rounds = early,
  verbose               = 1
)


# 4) Predictions & RMSE

# a) With AoA, no XYZ
pred_train_with    <- predict(Model_GB_with_AoA, train_matrix_full_with_AoA)
pred_test_with     <- predict(Model_GB_with_AoA, test_matrix_full_with_AoA)
rmse_train_with    <- rmse(train_labels_full, pred_train_with)
rmse_test_with     <- rmse(test_labels_full,  pred_test_with)

# b) Without AoA, no XYZ
pred_train_without <- predict(Model_GB_without_AoA, train_matrix_full_without_AoA)
pred_test_without  <- predict(Model_GB_without_AoA, test_matrix_full_without_AoA)
rmse_train_without <- rmse(train_labels_full, pred_train_without)
rmse_test_without  <- rmse(test_labels_full,  pred_test_without)

# c) With XYZ, no AoA
pred_train_XYZ     <- predict(Model_GB_with_XYZ, train_matrix_full_XYZ)
pred_test_XYZ      <- predict(Model_GB_with_XYZ, test_matrix_full_XYZ)
rmse_train_XYZ     <- rmse(train_labels_full, pred_train_XYZ)
rmse_test_XYZ      <- rmse(test_labels_full,  pred_test_XYZ)

# d) With AoA + XYZ
pred_train_all     <- predict(Model_GB_with_AoA_XYZ, train_matrix_full_all)
pred_test_all      <- predict(Model_GB_with_AoA_XYZ, test_matrix_full_all)
rmse_train_all     <- rmse(train_labels_full, pred_train_all)
rmse_test_all      <- rmse(test_labels_full,  pred_test_all)

# --- 5) Print summary ---
cat("Model               | Train RMSE | Test RMSE\n")
cat("--------------------|------------|---------\n")
cat(sprintf("Taps + AoA          |   %6.4f   |  %6.4f\n", rmse_train_with,    rmse_test_with))
cat(sprintf("Taps only           |   %6.4f   |  %6.4f\n", rmse_train_without, rmse_test_without))
cat(sprintf("Taps + XYZ          |   %6.4f   |  %6.4f\n", rmse_train_XYZ,     rmse_test_XYZ))
cat(sprintf("Taps + AoA + XYZ    |   %6.4f   |  %6.4f\n", rmse_train_all,     rmse_test_all))



```

# Plot performance between models
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(svglite)
rmse_values <- tibble::tibble(
  Model = c(
    # GAM
    "GAM_with_AoA","GAM_with_AoA_XYZ","GAM_without_AoA","GAM_without_AoA_XYZ",
    # LM
    "LM_with_AoA","LM_with_AoA_XYZ","LM_without_AoA","LM_without_AoA_XYZ",
    # RF
    "RF_with_AoA","RF_with_AoA_XYZ","RF_without_AoA","RF_without_AoA_XYZ",
    # XGBoost
    "XGBoost_with_AoA","XGBoost_with_AoA_XYZ","XGBoost_without_AoA","XGBoost_without_AoA_XYZ"
  ),
  RMSE_Train = c(
    # GAM
    stats_GAM_with_AoA$rmse_train,
    stats_GAM_with_AoA_with_XYZ$rmse_train,
    stats_GAM_without_AoA$rmse_train,
    stats_GAM_without_AoA_with_XYZ$rmse_train,
    # LM
    stats_LM_with_AoA$rmse_train,
    stats_LM_with_AoA_with_XYZ$rmse_train,
    stats_LM_without_AoA$rmse_train,
    stats_LM_without_AoA_with_XYZ$rmse_train,
    # RF
    stats_RF_with_AoA$rmse_train,
    stats_RF_with_AoA_XYZ$rmse_train,
    stats_RF_without_AoA$rmse_train,
    stats_RF_without_AoA_XYZ$rmse_train,
    # XGBoost
    rmse_train_with,      # taps + AoA
    rmse_train_all,       # taps + AoA + XYZ
    rmse_train_without,   # taps only
    rmse_train_XYZ        # taps + XYZ
  ),
  RMSE_Test = c(
    # GAM
    stats_GAM_with_AoA$rmse_test,
    stats_GAM_with_AoA_with_XYZ$rmse_test,
    stats_GAM_without_AoA$rmse_test,
    stats_GAM_without_AoA_with_XYZ$rmse_test,
    # LM
    stats_LM_with_AoA$rmse_test,
    stats_LM_with_AoA_with_XYZ$rmse_test,
    stats_LM_without_AoA$rmse_test,
    stats_LM_without_AoA_with_XYZ$rmse_test,
    # RF
    stats_RF_with_AoA$rmse_test,
    stats_RF_with_AoA_XYZ$rmse_test,
    stats_RF_without_AoA$rmse_test,
    stats_RF_without_AoA_XYZ$rmse_test,
    # XGBoost
    rmse_test_with,       # taps + AoA
    rmse_test_all,        # taps + AoA + XYZ
    rmse_test_without,    # taps only
    rmse_test_XYZ         # taps + XYZ
  )
)

# --- parse model name ---
clean <- rmse_values %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Model, "_reduced$")) %>%
  mutate(
    ModelType = str_replace(Model, "_.*$", ""),          # GAM / LM / RF / XGBoost
    GroupRaw  = str_replace(Model, "^[^_]+_", ""),       # with_AoA / with_AoA_XYZ / without_AoA / without_AoA_XYZ
    # for historic compatibility; your strings already say "XGBoost_*"
    ModelType = recode(ModelType, GB = "XGBoost"),
    ID = case_when(
      ModelType == "GAM"     & GroupRaw == "with_AoA"        ~ "a",
      ModelType == "GAM"     & GroupRaw == "with_AoA_XYZ"    ~ "b",
      ModelType == "GAM"     & GroupRaw == "without_AoA"     ~ "c",
      ModelType == "GAM"     & GroupRaw == "without_AoA_XYZ" ~ "d",
      ModelType == "LM"      & GroupRaw == "with_AoA"        ~ "e",
      ModelType == "LM"      & GroupRaw == "with_AoA_XYZ"    ~ "f",
      ModelType == "LM"      & GroupRaw == "without_AoA"     ~ "g",
      ModelType == "LM"      & GroupRaw == "without_AoA_XYZ" ~ "h",
      ModelType == "RF"      & GroupRaw == "with_AoA"        ~ "i",
      ModelType == "RF"      & GroupRaw == "with_AoA_XYZ"    ~ "j",
      ModelType == "RF"      & GroupRaw == "without_AoA"     ~ "k",
      ModelType == "RF"      & GroupRaw == "without_AoA_XYZ" ~ "l",
      ModelType == "XGBoost" & GroupRaw == "with_AoA"        ~ "m",
      ModelType == "XGBoost" & GroupRaw == "with_AoA_XYZ"    ~ "n",
      ModelType == "XGBoost" & GroupRaw == "without_AoA"     ~ "o",
      ModelType == "XGBoost" & GroupRaw == "without_AoA_XYZ" ~ "p",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ID = factor(ID, levels = letters[1:16]),
    Group = case_when(
      GroupRaw == "with_AoA"        ~ "12 Δp + AoA",
      GroupRaw == "with_AoA_XYZ"    ~ "12 Δp + AoA + Δx,Δy,Δz",
      GroupRaw == "without_AoA"     ~ "12 Δp",
      GroupRaw == "without_AoA_XYZ" ~ "12 Δp + Δx,Δy,Δz",
      TRUE ~ GroupRaw
    ),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("12 Δp","12 Δp + AoA","12 Δp + AoA + Δx,Δy,Δz","12 Δp + Δx,Δy,Δz"))
  ) %>%
  # drop rows with missing RMSE values (if any model didn't run)
  filter(!is.na(RMSE_Train), !is.na(RMSE_Test)) %>%
  arrange(ID)

# --- long format for plotting ---
long <- clean %>%
  select(ID, ModelType, Group, RMSE_Train, RMSE_Test) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(RMSE_Train, RMSE_Test),
               names_to = "Dataset", values_to = "RMSE") %>%
  mutate(Dataset = recode(Dataset, RMSE_Train = "Train", RMSE_Test = "Test")) %>%
  arrange(ModelType, ID, Dataset)

# --- plot ---
model_RMSE_plot <- ggplot(long, aes(x = ID, y = RMSE, color = Group, shape = Dataset)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "Model configuration (ID: a–p)", y = "RMSE",
       color = "Prediction group:", shape = "Dataset:") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 1)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    axis.line = element_line(color="black"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(byrow = TRUE),
         color = guide_legend(byrow = TRUE)) +
  facet_grid(~ ModelType, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")

print(model_RMSE_plot)

# --- save ---
if (!dir.exists("Predictive_model_data")) dir.create("Predictive_model_data")
if (!dir.exists("Predictive_model_data/plot")) dir.create("Predictive_model_data/plot")

ggsave("Predictive_model_data/plot/Model_performance_RMSE_Plot.svg",
       plot = model_RMSE_plot,
       device = svglite::svglite,
       width = 9, height = 5, units = "in",
       bg = "transparent")
```

## Latex table converter
```{r}
write_rmse_latex <- function(clean, file = "Table_S1_RMSE.txt", digits = 3) {
  stopifnot(all(c("ID","ModelType","GroupRaw","RMSE_Train","RMSE_Test") %in% names(clean)))

  # order: a..p and model types in GAM, LM, RF, XGBoost
  ord <- clean |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      ID = factor(ID, levels = letters[1:16]),
      ModelType = factor(ModelType, levels = c("GAM","LM","RF","XGBoost"))
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(ModelType, ID)

  predict_label <- function(gr) switch(gr,
    "with_AoA"        = "12 $\\Delta p$ + AoA",
    "with_AoA_XYZ"    = "12 $\\Delta p$ + AoA + dx + dy + dz",
    "without_AoA"     = "12 $\\Delta p$",
    "without_AoA_XYZ" = "12 $\\Delta p$ + dx + dy + dz",
    gr
  )

  fmt <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "--", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))

  lines <- c(
    "        \\textbf{ID} & \\textbf{Model type} & \\textbf{Model predictor} & ",
    "        \\multicolumn{2}{c}{\\textbf{RMSE}} \\\\",
    "         & & & \\textit{Train data} & \\textit{Test data} \\\\",
    "         & & & \\textit{(Test I)} & \\textit{(Test II)} \\\\",
    "        \\hline"
  )

  for (mt in levels(ord$ModelType)) {
    block <- ord[ord$ModelType == mt, ]
    # Ensure 4 rows per block in ID order
    block <- block[order(block$ID), ]

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(block))) {
      row <- block[i, ]
      mt_col <- if (i == 1) paste0("\\multirow[t]{4}{*}{", mt, "}") else ""

      pred <- predict_label(row$GroupRaw)
      tr   <- fmt(row$RMSE_Train)
      te   <- fmt(row$RMSE_Test)

      # Gray highlight for 'p'
      if (as.character(row$ID) == "p") lines <- c(lines, "        \\rowcolor{gray!20}")

      lines <- c(lines,
        sprintf("        %s & %s & %s & %s & %s \\\\",
                as.character(row$ID), mt_col, pred, tr, te)
      )
    }
    lines <- c(lines, "        \\hline")
  }

  writeLines(lines, file)
  message("Wrote: ", normalizePath(file))
}

# ---- Use it:
write_rmse_latex(clean, file = "Predictive_model_data/Latex_table_S1_RMSE.txt", digits = 3)
```
